status: Implemented full-picture portrait composition; earlier constant-crop samples retained as rejected bounded evidence.

studyScope.overview: Source-wide contact sheet plus shared-scene source-frame stills. Bounded visual review; no exhaustive cut reconstruction or browser playback proof.

activePicture.preserve: Complete horizontal source frame; remove only baked matte rows.

rejectedConstantCrop.failure: A full-height portrait cover retains under one quarter of the authored horizontal picture. Off-center head/hand details and widely separated conversational figures leave that crop. One central anchor cannot preserve the source edit.

cropCandidateSamples.observedSubject: Foreground seated figure is left of the current crop center. The current source-left boundary crosses the head region.
cropCandidateSamples.status: Single-frame estimate only; not a tracked interval or safe interpolated camera path.

cropCandidateSamples.observedSubject: Foreground leaning figure occupies the right side; this differs substantially from the earlier seated framing.
cropCandidateSamples.status: Single-frame estimate only; not a tracked interval or safe interpolated camera path.

recommendedPortrait.background: Only the same current decoded source frame, scaled/defocused/dimmed to fill the portrait. Root scene owns exact display settings; no generated scene, substitute poster, time-shifted clip or independently readable duplicate figure.
recommendedPortrait.vocalReading: Independent centered lead and backing regions: lead baseline 1080, backing baseline 1300. Spectrum baseline 1570, width 830, maximum authored band travel 112. Original source-word intervals stay unchanged.
recommendedPortrait.cameraPolicy: No new automatic pans or zooms. Every original scene transition remains on its source clock.
recommendedPortrait.why: Preserves both characters, gesture ownership, original framing and rapid cut structure throughout the edit; avoids a large incomplete anchor table whose gaps conceal clipped subjects.

acceptanceChecks: Inspect both scene edges, hands, faces and original titles in the sharp picture at every reviewed source change.
Check the complete moving video after seeking and format changes; still composition is not browser-picture evidence.
Keep ambient duplicates defocused and low enough to avoid a second recognizable actor competing with the sharp picture.
Verify lead/backing block clearance, inactive/active contrast and fixed spectrum footprint at realistic phone size.
Regenerate shared-scene stills and current input hashes after the portrait change.
